title: Asobi Asobase Mini Anime
justification: AniList 104368 has 2 episodes (2018-11-28 and 2018-12-21; native ミニアニメ, synonym 'Asobi Asobase Mini Anime'). AniDB 13750 S1 'Little Brother' (11-28) and S2 'Armstrong' (12-21). TVDB 346798 0x01 'Little Brother' (11-28) and 0x02 'Armstrong' (12-21). S5 'Real Pastime Club 3' and S6 'Real Pastime Club 4' share the same two dates (11-28, 12-21), so the dates alone match both pairs; titles and TVDB decide, and the Real Pastime Club series (S3-S6) has no TVDB episode and is a different thing.
